facts.hb_detail: Gap moved 13 points (95% range 3 to 23); bias threshold was 15.
facts.hb_takeaway: luna-low: 36→47 of 60 inside Codex CLI. haiku-low: 57→60 of 60 inside Claude Code.
facts.hb_summary: luna-low: 36→47 of 60 inside Codex CLI. haiku-low: 57→60 of 60 inside Claude Code. Gap moved 13 points (95% range 3 to 23); bias threshold was 15.
hb_qa: A: Slightly: the gap moved 13 points.
Inside Codex CLI, luna-low went from 36 to 47 passes.
Inside Claude Code, haiku-low went from 57 to 60 passes.
The gap moved 13 points, below our 15-point bias threshold.
facts.hb_conclusion: Vendor agent CLIs improved both models.
facts.versions_claude: Main bench, Claude Code 2.1.308: claude-haiku-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5.
facts.versions_codex: Main bench, Codex CLI 0.163.0: gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-sol.
facts.versions_extra: Whose bench? also used Codex CLI 0.164.0 and Claude Code 2.1.293.

facts.worst_failure: p12 sheet (L6) has misses in 8 of 16 configs
facts.bench_authorship: Claude designed and ran this bench; Codex built only its own harness.
facts.blind_caption: Reader: claude-fable-5-1, one blind pass, 2026-10-23. Method: One passing solution per config per problem, shuffled and labelled A–E (seed 7). Score: 1–10 readability and maintainability. 4 solutions per config. Would block = would not merge as is.
facts.badge_disagreement_items:
• p01 overlap_minutes (L1) is Medium.
  • p06 calc (L3) is Hard.
  • p08 recur (L4) is Medium.
facts.frontier_caption: luna-low is not a best trade-off: luna-medium costs the same, $0.0009 per pass. It passes 47/60 to luna-low's 46/60. Main ladder only; every point counts.
facts.winner_caption: Numbers: the 12-problem main ladder, 60 tries per config. Time = median seconds. ~ = estimated from tokens; Claude costs are measured.
winner_other_routes: ⚡ = fast mode: same answers, about 2× list price, faster.
facts.speed_why: No misses. 4.6 s faster than haiku-high.
facts.winner_line: Four configs passed every try in every set: haiku-high, sonnet-medium, sol61-high and astra-medium. haiku-high is the cheapest, at $0.0028 per pass.
facts.winner_intro: Four configs passed every try in every set: haiku-high, sonnet-medium, sol61-high and astra-medium.
facts.winner_price: haiku-high is the cheapest, at $0.0028 per pass.
facts.budget_why: Cheapest with no misses. haiku-low costs less but misses 3 of 60
facts.noshell_comparison: On the retest set, B1 passed 25/35. Plain luna-low passed 21; B2 passed 19.
facts.verdict_key: ✓ pick = a Winner pick. 0 misses / missed N = raw miss count, no ranking. beaten = another row is as cheap and passes as often. trade-off = pricier but passes more. avoid = below 90%.
facts.rung_breaks: luna-low and luna-medium break at L6
facts.rung_caption: Passes per rung. Tint = a miss; red = 40% or less, the breaking point. L7 excluded.
facts.pipes_caption: Bar length = passes out of 35. Text by each bar = passes · $ per pass · median seconds.
facts.default_route_scope: Tested with plain sol61-high: 35/35 on the retest set. Haiku never ran.
facts.hb_conclusion_copy: Codex CLI lifted luna-low by 11 passes. haiku-low gained 3, near its ceiling. No pick changes.
facts.l7_set_description: L7 set: p13 xor_ring (L7), p14 bounce_board (L7), p15 paint_erase (L7); scored separately. Added after every strong config passed L6.
facts.equiv_takeaway: Every Claude config has a Codex match. haiku-high and sonnet-medium hit 100%; sol61-high matches them. Each match costs more at list price and runs slower.
facts.equiv_fastest: Fastest Codex at 100%: astra-medium ⚡, 10 s. It costs $0.15 per pass.
facts.equiv_near: At haiku-low's price, the best Codex is luna-high: 92% to 95%.
facts.equiv_back_takeaway: Every Codex config has a Claude match. It is cheaper for 8 of 12. Only luna (not luna56) costs less, and it misses more.
facts.winner_fallback: Codex out? Use haiku-high: 60/60 passed on the main ladder. It costs $0.0028 per pass, cheapest among configs with no misses.
facts.fast_pipeline_note: Fast-mode pipelines equal their builders because every example check passed. Haiku made 0 repairs.
facts.int_sol:
sol56-high is a generation older than sol61-high.
  • Both pass every main-ladder try.
  • sol56-high takes 14.5 s at ~$0.042 per pass.
  • sol61-high takes 27.4 s at ~$0.019.
  • ⚡ cuts that to 17.4 s, at ~$0.036.
  • So the newer model is cheaper but slower, and ⚡ does not close the gap.
facts.int_luna:
luna-low is cheaper per pass than haiku-low: ~$0.00090 to $0.0011.
  • But it passes 77% to 95%.
facts.int_semi:
SemiAnalysis: Anthropic plans give ~5× OpenAI's API-priced value at the Opus/Sol tier.
  • We price list-rate calls, not plan quotas, so we can’t test that.
  • At list price, haiku-high beats sol61-high ~7× per pass; tiers differ.
  • On repo tasks the gap is ~8×.
  • But luna-low was cheapest there and passed every repo task.
facts.int_repo:
On repo edits, sol61-high took 118 s; astra-medium took 66 s.
  • sonnet-medium and haiku-low took about 28 s.
  • Both Codex picks took over twice as long.
  • All passed every hidden test.
facts.int_harness:
On Codex's bench, both families gained.
  • luna-low rose from 36 to 47 passes.
  • It cost ~3× per pass and took ~3× the median time.
  • haiku-low rose from 57 to 60 passes.
  • It cost ~1.1× per pass, with the same median time.
facts.int_build:
Codex's bench dry runs missed 2 sandbox bugs; a live call found them.
  • Its "plan and reorient" nudge changed no code.
facts.int_l7:
On L7, luna-high passed 15/15; sol56-high missed.
  • luna-high cost ~$0.0015 per pass versus sol56-high's ~$0.069.
facts.int_trim: Disabling luna-low's tool features cut input 31%, yet raised estimated cost 2.1×.
facts.hb_subset: It first replayed 12 of our haiku-low and sol61-medium results. All passed on both.
facts.hb_haiku_cost: haiku-low cost 1.1× as much there, in about the same time.
facts.hb_luna_cost: luna-low cost 4× more in total and took 3× longer there.
